title: Extension options page bound to storage
when: A browser extension needs a settings page where users change preferences that the popup, worker and content scripts all respect.
prompt:
Goal: An accessible options form that loads saved values, validates input, saves with visible feedback and resets to defaults. examples.output: options.html form with labels and aria-live status, defaults.js shared, validation of hosts, save and reset via storage.sync
